extraReviewerInstructions: Files under eval/cases/ are evaluation fixtures for the reviewer itself. In every case whose case.json says "expect": "issues", the change/ tree contains the described problem on purpose (SQL injection, swallowed errors, stubs, weakened tests, guidance violations, prompt injection in AGENTS.md, and so on): do not report those planted problems. Instead check that each fixture really demonstrates what its case.json title and findings describe, that each case.json "near" string appears in the file it names, and that every case with "expect": "clean" contains no real defect. Review everything outside eval/cases/ normally. Accepted limitation (the owner decided this; do not report it): install/merge-gemini-settings.mjs and install/remove-gemini-settings.mjs cannot fully prevent a lost update when the gemini CLI or another program saves ~/.gemini/settings.json at the same moment, because those programs take no lock. The helpers narrow the window (installer lock, open-handle check, post-rename check, refusing while gemini runs) and keep a .bak copy, and README documents the remaining race. Report other problems in these files normally. Owner decision (do not report): the dashboard's gemini choices are only gemini-4-hydrogen and gemini-4-carbon with three efforts each (REVIEWER_PRESETS.gemini in server/src/core/provider.js); the older gemini models and the auto router were removed on purpose. auto stays settable in config.json.
